text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for my first battle against Taiki! She says she would've preferred to race me when I'm feeling better, but I feel the opposite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All of these hindrances I've had to face have led me to new possibilities! I'm going to test if I can take on the world with this new running of mine!
